tools.name: kimodo_help
tools.description: Return the command manual, detailed parameter documentation for one command, or currently viable model configurations.

command.description: Command name whose full manual entry should be returned.

tools.name: kimodo_install_server
tools.description: Install or refresh the QuickServer runtime before starting the normal Command workflow. This preserves models and the Python environment, then restarts the server.

tools.name: session_get_or_create
tools.description: Create an empty current animation Session, or reopen an existing named Session. Add a scene humanoid before using character-scoped commands in a new Session.

name.description: Stable Session name. An existing name selects that Session; omit it to return the current Session or create one when none exists.

tools.name: session_close
tools.description: Close the selected animation editing Session while preserving its Timeline, assets, and AI-readable Session JSON.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

tools.name: session_add
tools.description: Add scene or project content to the current Session. kind=character adds one scene Humanoid Animator or renderable Mesh object; kind=clip appends one project AnimationClip to a Session character; kind=animator imports same-Layer State-to-State transitions as Timeline-composed transition_clip records without baking transition assets. Returns safe names to reuse. Appended clips keep a fixed 4-frame safezone.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

character.description: Scene character name/path for kind=character, or target Session character name otherwise.

ignore_warning.description: Import all transition variants when the projected transition count exceeds 128; defaults to false.

tools.name: animation_analyze
tools.description: Analyze one or two immutable Session clips and render their visual evidence synchronously. Humanoid characters use HumanBodyBones and return keyframes/foot contacts; non-humanoid renderable Mesh objects use a Mesh-only pose-sampling path and return pose pictures without humanoid contact data. Each clip explicitly names its Session character. Completed Clips are never modified.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

clips.description: One or two immutable Session clip references. Every item explicitly names its Session character; role defaults to source for the first item and target for the second.

resolution.description: Final picture tile resolution in pixels; accepts 64 through 4096. Rendering uses a 2x supersample and downsamples to this size. Defaults to 512.

tools.name: animation_compare
tools.description: Compare two animation ranges or transition-like clip ranges without modifying the Session.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

origin.description: Origin animation and half-open frame range.

target.description: Target animation and half-open frame range.

tools.name: kimodo_record_range
tools.description: Record a Session time range into an AnimationClip and append it to the source character.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

character.description: Safe source character name in the current Session.

remove_root_motion.description: Keep vertical motion but remove horizontal root translation and yaw; defaults to false.

output_folder.description: Unity folder under Assets; defaults to Assets/KimodoGeneratedClips.

tools.name: kimodo_retarget_animation
tools.description: Retarget one loaded animation to another current Session character and append the result.

session_id.description: Session id; omitted uses the current Session.

source_character.description: Safe source character name in the selected Session.

target_character.description: Safe target character name in the selected Session.

output_folder.description: Unity folder under Assets; defaults to Assets/KimodoGeneratedClips.

tools.name: kimodo_generate_animation
tools.description: Start asynchronous generation for a character in the current Session. The accepted request is recorded in session.json and must be polled by request_id.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

duration_frames.description: Duration in 60 FPS Session frames; defaults to 300.

loop.description: Enable bounded loop preprocessing; over-limit requests fall back to normal generation.

model.description: Registered model name/configuration id; omitted uses the Project Settings default. Use kimodo_help({section:'models'}) to query models.

seed.description: Deterministic seed; omitted chooses a random seed.

diffusion_steps.description: Diffusion steps; omitted uses the model default.

output_folder.description: Unity folder under Assets; defaults to Assets/KimodoGeneratedClips.

name.description: Requested safe animation name; defaults to the prompt.

analysis_option.description: Optional analysis object; set keyframes.enabled=true to return screenshot keyframes.

constraints.description: Point constraints and continuous root_path constraints for the generated clip.

frame.description: Relative frame in the generated clip at 60 FPS.

pose.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.
External Pose slot in the current Session.
External Pose slot in the current Session.
External Pose slot in the current Session.
External Pose slot in the current Session.
External Pose slot in the current Session.

frame.description: First path frame; defaults to the clip start.

path.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.

tools.name: pose_get
tools.description: Sample one current-Session clip frame into a new External Pose slot. Returns the only reusable pose identity: {track,index}.

full_data.description: Return all 49 muscles and TQ channels; defaults to false.

tools.name: pose_create_path
tools.description: Create a reusable External Path Marker on a character Pose Track.

character.description: Safe character name in the current Session.

length.description: Positive path length in Track-space meters.

inverse.description: Traverse the path backwards; defaults to false.

tools.name: pose_contract
tools.description: Align a target External Pose end-effector to an origin External Pose and create a new External Pose slot.

origin.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.

target.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.

tools.name: pose_set_root_transform
tools.description: Modify the root transform of an External Pose slot.

pose.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.

tools.name: pose_set_muscle
tools.description: Modify one or more muscles of an External Pose slot.

pose.description: External Pose slot in the current Session.

muscles.description: Map of muscle channel names to values.

tools.name: kimodo_get_generation
tools.description: Get generation progress and the generated animation safe name.

request_id.description: Request id returned by a generate tool.

tools.name: kimodo_cancel_generation
tools.description: Cancel an active Kimodo generation request.

request_id.description: Request id returned by a generate tool.
